refusal_notes.LATEST_QUOTE_CONFLICT: 1 instant whose final event-time group holds two records with the same nanosecond stamp and different market values. Under the earlier single-record design this instant would have been handed a quote the reader rejects, which is the defect the complete-group design exists to prevent.
refusal_notes.QUOTE_STALE: 13 instants on 2026-09-07, a Monday the exchange was closed for Labor Day. The scan grid checks weekday and clock only and has no exchange calendar, so it asked 13 questions on a closed market. The provider answered 200 with an empty list. The reason code says STALE because the nearest quote belongs to the prior session; it cannot say the market was closed.
